[SWS_PHM_00223]
{DRAFT}
Switch Global Supervision Status from
kOK
to
kFAILED
⌈
If the
Global Supervision Status
is
kOK
, the
Elementary Super-
vision Status
of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is
kFAILED
and no supervision is in
Elementary Supervision Status kEXPIRED
, then the
Platform Health Management
shall change the
Global Supervision Sta-
tus
to
kFAILED
.
⌋
(RS_PHM_00111)
See transition (7) in figure 7.6.
